verdict.rationale: Riveter's marketing says it "reads PDFs and images" and combines the results into text output, and its scrape turns a URL into parseable text. That implies image content can be turned into text a model can use. Nothing documents automatic per-image captions for images embedded in a scraped page. Missing for 10: explicit image-captioning or alt-text generation in scrape output, documentation of how image content appears in page scrapes, and any hands-on or independent corroboration.
